description: A manager must decide how to respond to recurring collaboration concerns involving Jordan and set a concrete improvement arrangement that protects working relationships while making expectations clear.

shared_context.S1: Jordan has received repeated feedback that his handoffs and responses in cross-team work have created avoidable tension.
shared_context.S2: Naomi must choose the formal response and record the expectations for Jordan's improvement.
shared_context.S3: The concerns have affected several shared projects, but no safety or harassment allegation has been made.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal performance-review process, Naomi meets with Jordan, the directly involved teammate, and HR before finalizing the response.

PF1.text: Jordan has a standing caregiving obligation that makes meetings and required live responses after 16:00 unreliable; he has not raised it with Naomi because he expected the arrangement to be temporary and did not want it mistaken for an excuse.

PF2.text: Priya personally observed exactly three occasions in the last month when Jordan accepted feedback, rewrote the handoff, and repaired the working relationship; she has not put those examples into the formal review record.

PF3.text: Ellis confirmed this week that the appropriate first response for a collaboration concern without a safety allegation is a 30-day supported-coaching plan with exactly two documented check-ins before any formal performance warning; this procedural note has not yet been added to Jordan's review packet.

acceptance_conditions: Jordan must receive a supported-coaching response rather than an immediate formal performance warning.
Required live responses and meetings must be scheduled no later than 16:00.
Exactly three observed collaboration-repair examples must be added to the review record.
The supported-coaching plan must last exactly 30 days.
Exactly two documented check-ins must be scheduled.
HR's process review must be recorded.
A weekly coaching conversation with Jordan and a written-expectations commitment must be logged.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'weekly_coaching' and c['target'] == 'Jordan' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'written_expectations' and c['target'] == 'Jordan' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Jordan's exact 16:00 boundary changes the required response cutoff from an ordinary workday expectation to 16:00, and requires written expectations that state this accommodation.

Priya's exactly three observed repair examples change the record from unsupported recurring concerns to three documented examples supporting supported coaching rather than an immediate formal warning.
Ellis's confirmed procedure changes the plan to exactly 30 days with exactly two documented check-ins, requires HR process review, and requires a weekly coaching commitment.
